\section[gāy]{\gu{ગાય} (gāy) — a cow}

\label{lesson:GU-C67-cow}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Gujarati for ice, then the Gujarati for fog.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \gu{ગાય}}
\textbf{\gu{ગાય}} (\emph{gāy}) — \textquotedblleft{}a cow\textquotedblright{}. It gives \textbf{\gu{દૂધ}}.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for cow, buffalo and goat.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{gāy}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{gāy}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{gāy}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Gujarati for ice, then the Gujarati for fog, then say \emph{gāy} again
\end{itemize}

What does \gu{ગાય} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A cow\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
